findings.issue: それとも joins two interrogatives, but the example is punctuated with 。 and no ？, so the JP reads as two declarative statements ('vou de café. ou de chá.') while the pt-BR gloss is a question. Needs ？ on both clauses.
findings.current: コーヒーにする。それとも紅茶にする (Você vai querer café, ou então chá?)
findings.suggested: コーヒーにする？それとも紅茶にする？ (Você vai querer café ou chá?)

findings.issue: 眺めを眺めた repeats the same root (noun + its own verb) and is unnatural Japanese; a native speaker would use 景色を眺めた or 眺めを楽しんだ.
findings.current: <jp reading="やまのうえからのながめをながめた">山の上からの眺めを眺めた</jp>
findings.suggested: 山の上から景色を眺めた (reading: やまのうえからけしきをながめた)

findings.issue: Ungrammatical pt-BR translation: 'sujar' takes the dirtied thing as object ('sujar o vestido de lama'), so 'Sujou lama no vestido' does not parse. The JP means mud stuck to the dress and won't come out.
findings.current: ドレスに泥が付いて取れない</jp><text> (Sujou lama no vestido e não sai.)
findings.suggested: (Grudou lama no vestido e não sai.)

findings.issue: Unnatural JP example: the noun 眺め and the verb 眺めた repeat the same lexeme in one clause (眺めを眺めた). No native writer would produce this; a different object or verb is needed.
findings.current: 山の上からの眺めを眺めた (やまのうえからのながめをながめた)
findings.suggested: 山の上から景色を眺めた (reading: やまのうえからけしきをながめた)

findings.issue: pt-BR translation of ドレスに泥が付いて取れない is syntactically wrong: 'sujar' takes the dirtied item as object ('sujou o vestido de lama'), not the dirt.
findings.current: (Sujou lama no vestido e não sai.)
findings.suggested: (O vestido sujou de lama e a mancha não sai.)
